question: Can the Bautista and Barila Candaba fish-inventory thesis be independently identified or used as species evidence?

source.titleAsCited: An inventory of the different species of Fishes in Candaba Swamo, Pampanga
source.attributionAsCited: Bautista, M. & Barila, J.V.; BS Thesis, PAC, Magalang, Pampanga.

yearConflict.note: Mallari et al. (2020) cites Bautista & Barila (2013) in its introduction but lists Bautista & Barila (2003) in its bibliography. The bibliography also prints 'Swamo'. No original thesis or independent catalog record was found in this bounded search to resolve the discrepancies.

source.accessNote: The official publisher article page and PDF were reviewed only to verify that the thesis is cited and to record the conflicting years and title spelling. Exact-title, author/title, and PSAU/Pampanga Agricultural College targeted web searches did not locate an independently accessible thesis catalog record or thesis copy. This bounded search does not prove that no physical or non-indexed record exists.

scopeAndEvidenceLimits.waterbodyScope: Candaba Swamp is named in the secondary citation; no sampling stations, dates, barangay/site matrix, coordinates, or validated wetland geometry are supplied by the citation.
scopeAndEvidenceLimits.speciesEvidence: No species names, methods, counts, vouchers, or results from the Bautista and Barila thesis were reviewed. Species listed elsewhere in Mallari et al. (2020) are not attributed to this thesis by this review.
scopeAndEvidenceLimits.institutionLabel: The secondary citation says 'PAC, Magalang, Pampanga'. The institution's full historical name, thesis catalog number, and current holding were not independently verified.
scopeAndEvidenceLimits.reuse: No thesis-specific license, permission, or reproduction terms were available. The secondary citation does not grant reuse rights.

alternativeSearch.approach: Searched the exact title, the author/title combination, the spelling variant 'Swamo', and PSAU/Pampanga Agricultural College domain-qualified terms for an independent catalog or lawful full-text record.
alternativeSearch.result: The reviewed results led back to the 2020 secondary citation; no independent thesis record or copy was identified.
alternativeSearch.outreach: No email or access request was sent.

nextAction: Treat the thesis as an unresolved bibliographic lead. If the source becomes important, seek an authorized PSAU library catalog/holding lookup or a lawful copy, first resolving its year, title, author identities, institution, and reproduction terms; then evaluate any species, methods, site, date, and voucher evidence independently.

sources.supports: Official publisher article metadata and the bibliography's 2003 year/title spelling for the thesis citation.
The introduction's 2013 citation, the bibliography's 2003 citation and 'Swamo' spelling; the thesis contents were not accessed.
